title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Solid Brass | Carolina Collection (Traditional) Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bath with a recessed toilet paper holder that saves space and delivers a streamlined, built-in look in a timeless traditional style.

  • Carolina Collection: Designed to coordinate with matching Carolina pieces for a cohesive, classic bath
  • Recessed in-wall mount: Creates a clean, space-saving installation
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted for enduring use
  • Concealed mounting: Hidden screw hardware for a refined finished appearance
  • Designer finish options: Available in 28 finishes, including statement colors

Specifications

  • Category: Toilet Paper Holders
  • Collection: Carolina (Traditional/Classic)
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Recessed
  • Dimensions: 6.125-Inch L x 6.125-Inch H x 4-Inch W
  • Projection: 4-Inch
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Recessed toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
